page.overview:
Who is Max Hart?

Doctor Max Hart is a minor character who appeared in .

Max Hart was a children's doctor at Haddonfield Children's Clinic. On Halloween Eve, Nurse Patsey had called him in as Jamie Lloyd was suffering from a convulsion. Dr. Hart tried to assist Jamie, but was stopped by Sam Loomis, who told him that Jamie was going to be alright, which turned out to be true. Later the following night, Michael Myers paid a visit to the Clinic and killed him and Patsey.
